summary: The claim and proof are correct. Smallest-dimension, empty-collection, singleton, nonintegral-budget, and nonsaturated-chart cases present no counterexample. The lattice-ball lower bound, full-rank box and simplex cardinality estimates, lower-rank projection bound, and budget aggregation establish the stated strict inequality for every permitted radius. The predecessor support, rank, budget, and probability-normalization aliases are explicit and consistent; no predecessor moment or disjoint-partition conclusion is invoked outside its hypotheses.
